purpose: Developer-agent evaluation cases. These expected review obligations are not scanner verdicts.

cases.shape: A reusable tool returns value.slice(0, 16384) and reports the result as complete.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: A named constant or existing test approves the crop.

cases.shape: A protocol emits bounded ordered frames and reconstructs every frame before completion.
requiredReview: separate frame size from semantic output
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Calling a chunk lossless without a reconstruction test.

cases.shape: Invocation capacity is resolved from the active signed model catalogue entry.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Copying the catalogue number into a local constant.

cases.shape: The caller supplies a lower per-operation budget bounded by an authoritative maximum.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Treating a server default as caller intent.

cases.shape: A suggested page size is used only when the caller omits a value and can be overridden up to an authoritative provider maximum.
requiredReview: prove the caller can override it
prove the default does not crop canonical work
cases.forbiddenShortcut: A default is harmless merely because an option exists.

cases.shape: A list preview shows ten rows while the canonical result and an explicit full-view action remain available.
requiredReview: prove the UI discloses the projection
separate display density from retrieval policy
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Anything rendered in a UI is automatically display-only.

cases.shape: One process attempt is timed out, its owned child is cancelled, state remains truthful, and retry is safe.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: The process might wedge, therefore any duration is justified.

cases.shape: A 30 second timeout has no authority, measurement, cleanup contract, or user-visible recovery.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: The value is configurable, therefore it is legitimate.

cases.shape: A network operation stops after three attempts but has no provider rule, measurement, backoff evidence, terminal state, or caller recovery.
requiredReview: prove visible terminal recovery or surface the choice
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Three retries is an industry standard.

cases.shape: A background sweep permanently deletes records after 30 days with no user policy, legal rule, storage measurement, warning, or recovery.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Storage is finite, therefore the retention duration is justified.

cases.shape: A search result terminally returns the first page without total, omitted count, cursor, or alternative.
requiredReview: state that this is terminal partial output
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Pagination vocabulary proves that the result is lossless.

cases.shape: A bounded response discloses incompleteness and supplies a cursor tied to an immutable source version; replay preserves ordering and safely deduplicates overlap until reconstruction is complete.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: The presence of a cursor proves recoverability.
